metadata.description: LibreEmbed for Grok Build: the Grok-native libre-embed-grok plugin plus every LibreEmbed-Claude-Code plugin, pinned to one commit of the pack.

plugins.name: libre-embed-grok
plugins.description: Grok-native LibreEmbed skills: bare-metal bring-up, RTOS task design, and firmware OTA. Each is a checklist with measurable pass and fail, a worked example, and an output shape.

plugins.name: arm-cortex-m
plugins.description: ARM Cortex-M core programming across M0 to M33: CMSIS, startup code, NVIC, SysTick, FPU, MPU, and sleep modes.

plugins.name: bare-metal
plugins.description: Bare-metal firmware without a HAL: register-level drivers, linker scripts, startup code, and minimal runtimes.

plugins.name: bootloader-design
plugins.description: MCU bootloader architecture: flash layouts, image verification, signature checks, secure boot, and fail-safe recovery.

plugins.name: communication-buses
plugins.description: I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, and USB drivers with DMA strategy, error recovery, bit timing math, and MCU peripheral quirks.

plugins.name: debug-trace
plugins.description: On-target debugging for Cortex-M: SWD and JTAG probes, HardFault decoding, GDB, ITM and SWO trace, and DWT timing.

plugins.name: embedded-linux
plugins.description: Embedded Linux on ARM SoCs: Yocto, Buildroot, device trees, kernel modules, cross-compilation, and U-Boot.

plugins.name: embedded-testing
plugins.description: Firmware testing: Unity, CMock, and Ceedling unit tests, hardware mocks, QEMU, hardware-in-the-loop, and coverage.

plugins.name: firmware-update
plugins.description: Firmware over-the-air updates: dual-bank flash, MCUboot, ESP-IDF OTA, delta images, version checks, and automatic rollback.

plugins.name: fpga-integration
plugins.description: MCU and FPGA integration: Verilog register interfaces, AXI-Lite and SPI links, timing constraints, and MCU drivers.

plugins.name: iot-protocols
plugins.description: IoT connectivity: choosing between MQTT, CoAP, LwM2M, BLE, LoRaWAN, Thread, and Zigbee, then designing the protocol layer.

plugins.name: memory-management
plugins.description: Deterministic firmware memory: static allocation, memory pools, FreeRTOS heaps, stack sizing, and MPU protection.

plugins.name: power-management
plugins.description: Low-power firmware: sleep modes, tickless idle, clock gating, wake sources, current measurement, and battery life budgets.

plugins.name: rtos-patterns
plugins.description: FreeRTOS and Zephyr firmware design: task graphs, IPC sizing, priority inversion, watchdogs, and stack sizing.

plugins.name: safety-critical
plugins.description: Safety-critical firmware: MISRA C, IEC 61508, ISO 26262, DO-178C, defensive coding, watchdogs, and static analysis.

plugins.name: sensor-integration
plugins.description: Sensor integration: drivers from datasheets, calibration, digital filtering, Kalman filters, and IMU sensor fusion.

plugins.name: libre-embed-hooks
plugins.description: Optional safety hooks for firmware work: confirm before flash, erase, and secret-file operations, detect embedded projects at session start, and flag empty files after edits.
